GW_LB.cumulative_bottom_exchange_error_cm: pooled RMSE of cumulative bottom exchange over all four histories and all observation windows
GW_LB.interval_bottom_flux_error_cm_per_day: pooled RMSE of observation-window mean bottom flux
GW_LB.bottom_flux_sign_mismatch_count: total exact sign mismatches over all histories and observations; zero remains a sign, no post-response deadband
GW_LB.reversal_sequence_mismatch_count: number of histories whose ordered nonzero-sign reversal sequence has different length
GW_LB.reversal_timing_error_steps: maximum paired reversal-step displacement when sequence lengths match; 1024-step penalty for a history with unequal sequence length
GW_LB.total_storage_error_cm: pooled RMSE of total column storage
GW_LB.history_signed_bottom_flux_bias_cm_per_d: maximum absolute per-history mean signed interval-bottom-flux error
GW_LB.long_horizon_exchange_drift_cm: maximum absolute final cumulative-bottom-exchange error across histories

SURF_P.surface_0_20_storage_error_cm: pooled RMSE of integrated 0-20 cm storage
SURF_P.root_zone_0_40_storage_error_cm: pooled RMSE of integrated 0-40 cm storage
SURF_P.upper_0_80_storage_error_cm: pooled RMSE of integrated 0-80 cm storage
SURF_P.mapped_10cm_theta_error: pooled RMSE across all 16 fixed 10-cm bins, histories and observations
SURF_P.total_storage_error_cm: pooled RMSE of total column storage
SURF_P.storage_extremum_timing_error_steps: maximum absolute argmin/argmax step displacement across 0-20, 0-40 and 0-80 cm storage, all histories
SURF_P.history_signed_storage_bias_cm: maximum absolute per-history mean signed storage error across the 0-20, 0-40, 0-80 and total-storage series

relations.componentwise_no_worse: candidate component <= comparator component + equality_tolerance on every frozen primary metric
relations.strict_improvement: at least one primary component < comparator component - equality_tolerance
relations.comparator_crossing: candidate error vector is componentwise no worse than R512_T32 relative to R2048_T32
relations.closure_deficit: same-partition coarse Richards crosses R512_T32 while same-partition CURRENT_LAYER_FACE Layer-ROM does not
